run.target: SINGLE Business Tenant + Party Actor foundation

rows.action: Resolve registration, Tenant provisioning and Party creation policies on the server
rows.assertion: SINGLE forces Tenant provisioning disabled and retains legacy registration compatibility without allowing it to weaken explicit policy

rows.action: Admit an allowed identity into the server-owned Default Business Tenant
rows.assertion: SINGLE creates/reuses the business TenantMember, rejects CLOSED registration and never selects System Tenant

rows.action: Block create/join/select product entry in SINGLE while preserving MULTI self-service
rows.assertion: Direct API calls are rejected in SINGLE; MULTI policy remains delegated; SINGLE browser exposes no Tenant self-service entry

groups.title: Complete Party and IAM data model

rows.action: Migrate Party 12 tables, IAM 5 tables, role scope and session context fields
rows.assertion: Fresh PostgreSQL reaches migration v20260809120000 and model round-trips without schema drift

rows.action: Keep Party persistence tenant-filtered with composite tenant foreign keys
rows.assertion: Party mapper observes current tenant and schema prevents cross-tenant membership/session references

rows.action: Resolve and repair the default LoginApplication/Channel/AuthMethod
rows.assertion: Schema-snapshot first install receives one default password surface and registry wins with safe legacy fallback

rows.action: Manage external IdP instances and orchestrate all OAuth/LDAP federation flows
rows.assertion: Stable tables exist, but unified management UI/runtime orchestration remains deliberately deferred and legacy social paths remain compatible

groups.title: Party lifecycle, authorization and Actor session

rows.action: Create a Party under approval policy and activate it
rows.assertion: Approval-required creates pending Party/Membership; approval makes the Actor eligible

rows.action: Switch to an active Party Actor
rows.assertion: Replacement session is minted before old revoke; new token is ready/party with cv increment, old token is rejected

rows.action: Evaluate active membership, PARTY role, capability and resource ownership
rows.assertion: Only the selected active Actor contributes PARTY roles; capability remains distinct; cross-Party resource access is denied

rows.action: Run generic invitation, capability approval, relation and business-network workflows
rows.assertion: Full model exists; general-purpose workflow/UI is intentionally deferred until a concrete domain needs it

groups.title: Web journey, SQL performance and falsifiability

rows.action: Log in to the unique business workspace and switch Business identity from the Header
rows.assertion: No registration/Tenant self-service entry; Actor switch persists and current Actor is visibly selected; console has no errors
rows.vision_check: Manually inspected login, /home, user menu, switch result and browser console in isolated runtime

rows.action: Query Party by fixed tenant and lifecycle at realistic fixture cardinality
rows.assertion: PostgreSQL uses idx_party_tenant_status; 20k-row transactional fixture is fully rolled back

rows.action: Remove tenant/member context before Party revalidation, observe red, restore and rerun
rows.assertion: Controlled mutation fails the crown-jewel test and restored code passes targeted plus final combined suite
